lowVoltageInspection.title: Low Voltage Inspection in Vinaròs
lowVoltageInspection.intro1: At Mantenimientos AJ, we provide professional low voltage inspections in the Valencian Community. This process ensures electrical installations operating under 1,000V AC or 1,500V DC are safe, functional, and compliant with regulations.
lowVoltageInspection.intro2: Low voltage inspections are crucial for fire prevention, as many emergencies are caused by electrical faults that could have been avoided with timely checks.

items.item1: Prevent electrical risks and fires: detect overloads, damaged cables, and poor connections.
items.item2: Ensure compliance with REBT and other electrical regulations.
items.item3: Protect people and property: reduce risk of electrocution or material damage.
items.item4: Guarantee safe power supply to fire protection systems.

items.item1: Condition and size of cables and conduits.
items.item2: Electrical panels and residual current devices.
items.item5: Electrical compatibility with fire safety equipment.

whoPerforms.title: Who should perform the inspection?
whoPerforms.description: The inspection must be carried out by specialized and certified technical personnel. In industrial facilities, public venues, or buildings with fire protection systems, these inspections are mandatory by regulation. At Mantenimientos AJ, we conduct regulatory inspections in the Valencian Community, providing a detailed report and tailored solutions.

fireMaintainceTitle: Professional Fire Protection Maintenance and Installation
fireMaintainceSubtitle: Your safety is our priority: comprehensive fire protection solutions.
fireMaintainceDescription: We specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of fire protection systems, offering customized solutions that ensure prevention, rapid detection, and effective response to emergencies in homes, industries, and commercial premises.

installations.title: Fire Protection System Installation Compliant with Current Regulations
installations.description: We develop systems tailored to each client's specific needs while meeting legal requirements to guarantee maximum safety:

items.item1: Advanced automatic fire detection systems (smoke, heat, gases).
items.item2: Water-based extinguishing systems: automatic sprinklers, hose reels, and hydrants.
items.item3: Clean gas extinguishing systems environmentally friendly (FM-200, CO₂).
items.item4: Clear signage and evacuation systems for safe exit.
items.item5: First intervention equipment for immediate fire control.

maintenance.title: Preventive and Corrective Maintenance for Optimal Performance
maintenance.description: We offer tailored maintenance plans to ensure your fire protection systems always operate at their best:

items.item1: Comprehensive periodic inspections with official documentation.
items.item2: Functionality, pressure, and condition tests of the equipment.
items.item3: Quick and safe replacement of defective components.
items.item4: Urgent technical support and immediate problem resolution.

benefits.title: Why choose us for your fire protection needs?

items.item1: We guarantee certification and strict compliance with national and international standards (UNE, NFPA, RIPCI).
items.item2: Highly qualified team with ongoing specialized training.
items.item3: Extensive experience in industrial, commercial, public, and residential sectors.
items.item4: Personalized service with rapid response and full commitment to your safety.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.paragraph1: Mantenimientos AJ is passionately committed to fire safety. Since day one, we have specialized in inspection, maintenance, and prevention of fire protection systems, providing comprehensive solutions tailored to each client's specific needs.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Our mission is clear and firm: to protect lives, property, and environments through high-quality technical services with a preventive focus. We adhere to the strictest safety standards and comply with national and international regulations, leveraging state-of-the-art technology to ensure reliable and effective results.
aboutPage.paragraph3: Our team consists of highly qualified professionals with extensive experience in risk detection, installation inspections, and specialized technical advice. At Mantenimientos AJ, we don't just inspect: we anticipate, prevent, and protect with dedication and responsibility.
aboutPage.paragraph4: We firmly believe prevention is the best investment. That's why we work closely with our clients — industries, companies, institutions, and communities — to create safer and more resilient environments against fire risks.
aboutPage.slogan: Your trusted ally in fire safety.
